measurement: These liners are universal fit and require no circumference measurement. Choose your liner type: Standard Sensil for reliable grip and comfort, or Sensil Anti Migration for maximum brace stability during high-activity rehab. Select RL/LM (Right Lateral/Left Medial) or RM/LL (Right Medial/Left Lateral) to match your Rebound Cartilage brace configuration. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
